note: Based on the species-level description of Trinervitermes nigrirostris in Chhotani (1997), original in English; the soldier is dimorphic, with the major and minor forms combined in one paragraph; all castes present; synonymic citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule brown, dark brown anteriorly; nasus dark brown, slightly paler at the tip; antennae pale brown; abdominal tergites smoky brown, sternites straw-coloured. Head with a few microscopic hairs, without long setae; margin of the pronotum with small hairs, also some on the body; abdominal tergites without long setae, sternites with long and short hairs. Total body length 4.1–4.7 mm. Head capsule subcircular excluding the nasus (length including nasus 2.15–2.38 mm, length excluding nasus 1.33–1.50 mm, maximum width 1.20–1.30 mm); in profile distinctly incurved behind the nasus; nasus swelling absent. Nasus subcylindrical (length 0.75–0.85 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.56–0.60). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 3 long, about 1.5 times segment 2; segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3 and segment 5. Mandibles vestigial, without a spine. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.20–0.28 mm, width 0.58–0.65 mm); anterior part strongly raised; anterior margin rounded, with a broad shallow median depression; posterior margin convex. Minor soldier: head capsule pale brown to brown, dark brown anteriorly; nasus dark brown; dorsal abdomen smoky brown. Head with only scattered microscopic hairs; margin of the pronotum with some small hairs; abdominal tergites with long and short hairs. Total body length 3.20–3.50 mm. Head capsule subrectangular excluding the nasus, slightly incurved laterally behind the antennae (length including nasus 1.55–1.64 mm, length excluding nasus 0.85–0.88 mm, width 0.62–0.63 mm); in profile concave, without a nasus swelling. Nasus long, cylindrical, slightly shorter than the head length excluding the nasus (length 0.70–0.76 mm). Antennae long, 13-segmented; segment 3 more than twice as long as segment 2; segment 4 about 1.5 times segment 2. Pronotum saddle-shaped, smaller than in the major soldier (length 0.19–0.20 mm, width 0.43–0.45 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head and dorsal abdomen smoky; antennae and postclypeus pale brown; sternites and legs whitish. Head and body surface rather densely hairy. Total body length 4.0–5.0 mm. Head subcircular, broader at the antennal bases (length to the base of the mandibles 1.30–1.40 mm, width 1.50–1.58 mm); coronal suture distinct. Frontal plate long, translucent. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 longer than segment 2. Postclypeus convex, hairy, about half as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped (length 0.30 mm, width 0.55–0.65 mm); anterior margin deeply excised, posterior margin nearly convex.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule and abdominal tergites chestnut brown; antennae, postclypeus, labrum, pronotum and legs brown; sternites pale brown. Head and body surface rather densely hairy. Total body length 19.0–19.5 mm with wings, 9.0–10.8 mm without wings. Head subcircular (length to the base of the mandibles 1.40–1.60 mm, width including compound eyes 1.90–2.00 mm); slightly concave in the middle of the dorsum; coronal suture absent. Frontal plate small, V-shaped, milk-white. Compound eyes medium-sized, subcircular, maximum diameter 0.55–0.60 mm. Ocelli oval, adjacent to the compound eyes, separated by less than half to nearly half the short diameter (long diameter 0.24–0.30 mm, short diameter 0.16–0.18 mm, eye–ocellus distance 0.06–0.09 mm). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus convex, hairy, less than half as long as wide. Pronotum subtrapezoidal (length 0.90–1.05 mm, width 1.70–1.90 mm); anterior margin nearly straight, without a median incision; posterior margin nearly straight or slightly convex, with a deep median impression. Wings yellow; membrane hairy and punctate; microstructure consisting of papillae (9–10 rows on the anterior margin, 2–3 on the posterior margin) and fine non-stellate microtrichia; fore wing 16.25–16.60 mm long, hind wing 14.50–15.50 mm long.
